verdict.rationale: Docs detail multiple registration methods (serial number, registration code, order number) that work immediately after unboxing, plus no-code Dashboard app and Tap to Pay options for taking a payment quickly, and fleet management via locations/zones. Community evidence corroborates real-world use for in-store payment acceptance. Missing for 10: independent hands-on account of actual pairing time/setup friction and no direct evidence of 'within minutes' onboarding speed claims being verified by third parties.
